results.name: Settings → Layout: picking Business swaps the top bar + shelf for a bottom taskbar; persisted across a reload
Business taskbar: open → minimise → restore on click, Shift+click new window, jump list, Show desktop round trip, clock → Planner
Business: Start menu opens above the taskbar at bottom-left, search + Enter launches; Quick settings and toasts sit bottom-right; Windows caption buttons
Quick panel → Layout: Art gives a menu bar and a centred dock holding EVERY app (+ Launchpad, Trash); no taskbar

Art dock: aesthetic size + stacks — size from the screen not the app count, groups fold into stacks (grid popover, arrows, Esc), a launched app from a folded group shows as its own running icon, size presets
Art dock magnification: measured peak under the pointer, cosine falloff, name bubble, stable under the pointer, reset on leave; off switch
Art dock: launch bounces and shows a running dot; minimise (traffic light) parks the window after the separator, click restores; right-click Quit
Art window chrome + menus: traffic lights left (close, minimise, zoom), centred title, Window menu tiles/zooms, zoomed window stops above the dock, Launchpad
keyboard + motion: Tab focus magnifies a dock icon and shows its name; reduced motion → no bounce, no transitions

phone 360×640 in Art: the page never scrolls sideways; every group folds into a stack and the dock fits at ≥32 px; with many minimised windows it scrolls inside itself, magnification off (honest fallback)
axe-core: Business with Enterprise and Art with Graphite, dark + light, Start menu / Launchpad / menus open — no serious or critical violations
